headline: Shell Delivers Highest Quarterly Profit Since 2022 and Expands Buybacks
summary: Energy major Shell reported its largest quarterly profit since 2022. Following the earnings surge, the company announced an expansion of its share buyback program.
why: Shell plc is a global energy and petrochemical enterprise headquartered in the United Kingdom and listed in London and New York.

impacts.name: Shell plc
impacts.why: Record quarterly profits and increased share repurchases directly enhance shareholder returns.

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings and increased shareholder returns boost investor sentiment in integrated oil and gas equities.
